recoverRequest.title: Reset your password — Foxnox
recoverRequest.heading: Forgot your password?
recoverRequest.subtitle: Enter the email address for your account. If it exists, we will send a reset link.
recoverRequest.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

recoverSent.title: Check your email — Foxnox
recoverSent.heading: Check your email
recoverSent.body: If an account exists for that address, you will receive a message with a link to reset your password. The link expires after a short time.

recoverReset.title: Choose a new password — Foxnox
recoverReset.heading: Choose a new password
recoverReset.subtitle: Pick a strong password you have not used here before.
recoverReset.errorWeak: Password does not meet the security policy.
recoverReset.errorInvalidToken: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
recoverReset.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

recoverDone.title: Password updated — Foxnox
recoverDone.heading: Password updated
recoverDone.body: Your password has been changed. You can sign in with your new password.

recoverInvalid.title: Link expired — Foxnox
recoverInvalid.heading: This link is no longer valid
recoverInvalid.body: The reset link is missing, invalid, or has expired. Request a new one to continue.

twofaVerify.title: Two-factor authentication — Foxnox
twofaVerify.heading: Enter your verification code
twofaVerify.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.
twofaVerify.errorInvalid: That code is not valid. Try again.
twofaVerify.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

twofaSetup.title: Set up two-factor authentication — Foxnox
twofaSetup.heading: Set up two-factor authentication
twofaSetup.subtitle: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter a code to confirm.
twofaSetup.errorInvalid: That code is not valid. Try again.
twofaSetup.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
twofaSetup.qrPlaceholder: QR code will appear here once setup is wired to the backend.

twofaDone.title: Two-factor enabled — Foxnox
twofaDone.heading: Two-factor authentication is on
twofaDone.body: Your account now requires a verification code when you sign in.

twofaDisabled.title: Two-factor disabled — Foxnox
twofaDisabled.heading: Two-factor authentication is off
twofaDisabled.body: Authenticator requirements were removed from your account. You can set 2FA up again after signing in.

accountRecoverRequest.title: Recover your account — Foxnox
accountRecoverRequest.heading: Lost access to two-factor authentication?
accountRecoverRequest.subtitle: Enter the email for your account. If it exists, we will start an account recovery challenge.
accountRecoverRequest.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

accountRecoverSent.title: Recovery started — Foxnox
accountRecoverSent.heading: Check your email
accountRecoverSent.body: If an account exists for that address, you will receive a recovery link. Use it together with your security questions to regain access.

accountRecoverChallenge.title: Prove your identity — Foxnox
accountRecoverChallenge.heading: Answer your security questions
accountRecoverChallenge.subtitle: Correct answers let us disable two-factor authentication so you can sign in again.
accountRecoverChallenge.errorInvalid: One or more answers are incorrect. Try again.
accountRecoverChallenge.errorInvalidToken: This recovery link is invalid or has expired.
accountRecoverChallenge.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

accountRecoverDone.title: Account recovered — Foxnox
accountRecoverDone.heading: Access restored
accountRecoverDone.body: Two-factor authentication was disabled. Sign in with your password, then set up 2FA again when you can.

securityQuestionsSetup.title: Security questions — Foxnox
securityQuestionsSetup.heading: Set up security questions
securityQuestionsSetup.subtitle: Choose questions only you can answer. They help recover your account if you lose access to 2FA.
securityQuestionsSetup.errorIncomplete: Select a question and provide an answer for each row.
securityQuestionsSetup.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

securityQuestionsDone.title: Security questions saved — Foxnox
securityQuestionsDone.heading: Security questions saved
securityQuestionsDone.body: Your answers are stored securely and can be used during account recovery.

trustedDevicePrompt.title: Remember this device — Foxnox
trustedDevicePrompt.heading: Trust this device?
trustedDevicePrompt.subtitle: Trusted devices can skip two-factor prompts for a limited time.
trustedDevicePrompt.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

trustedDeviceDone.title: Device trusted — Foxnox
trustedDeviceDone.heading: Device trusted
trustedDeviceDone.body: This device will not ask for a second factor until the trust period expires.

trustedDeviceSkipped.title: Continue without trusting — Foxnox
trustedDeviceSkipped.heading: Continuing without trust
trustedDeviceSkipped.body: You will be asked for a verification code the next time you sign in from this device.

trustedDevicesManage.title: Trusted devices — Foxnox
trustedDevicesManage.heading: Trusted devices
trustedDevicesManage.subtitle: Devices that can skip two-factor prompts. Revoke any you no longer use.
trustedDevicesManage.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

trustedDeviceRevoked.title: Device revoked — Foxnox
trustedDeviceRevoked.heading: Trust revoked
trustedDeviceRevoked.body: That device will need a verification code on the next sign-in.

passwordExpired.title: Password expired — Foxnox
passwordExpired.heading: Your password has expired
passwordExpired.subtitle: Choose a new password to continue. It must meet the security policy.
passwordExpired.errorWeak: Password does not meet the security policy.
passwordExpired.errorInvalidToken: This session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
passwordExpired.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

passwordExpiredDone.title: Password updated — Foxnox
passwordExpiredDone.heading: Password updated
passwordExpiredDone.body: Your password is valid again. Continue to sign in.

unlockRequest.title: Account locked — Foxnox
unlockRequest.heading: Account temporarily locked
unlockRequest.subtitle: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Enter your email to request an unlock, or wait until the lock expires.
unlockRequest.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

unlockSent.title: Unlock requested — Foxnox
unlockSent.heading: Unlock requested
unlockSent.body: If that account is locked, an unlock link or automatic release will follow shortly. You can also wait for the lock timer to expire.

unlockDone.title: Account unlocked — Foxnox
unlockDone.heading: Account unlocked
unlockDone.body: You can sign in again. Repeated failures will lock the account once more.

unlockInvalid.title: Unlock link invalid — Foxnox
unlockInvalid.heading: This unlock link is no longer valid
unlockInvalid.body: Request a new unlock or wait for the lock period to end.
